case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr Brandlhuber,

You wrote that your family foundry takes pride in supplying us and that you value our long standing relationship. We feel the same, and we want a fair solution for both family companies that keeps your shop in steady work.

Option A is the package we can approve. It sets a clear price with payment on a short term, and the claims below show why it is the right basis for both of us.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 125.45; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 126.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. To maintain our quality standards amidst rising costs, we can offer €134.80 per unit with 30-day payment terms. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. 

For our personal offer, we present a price of €137.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: a price of €134.80 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 January 2027. Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your movement and your commitment to finding a fair solution for both our family companies. 

In response to your revised offer, we are prepared to adjust our price to €136.50 per unit for Option A. This represents a significant concession on our part while ensuring we can maintain the quality standards you expect. For this price of €136.50 per unit, our offer includes a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Our foundry takes great pride in the work we do and the long relationship we have shared with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH over the years. We trust that this proposal reflects our sincere wish to continue our partnership successfully.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
